patterns.note: A full-width, fixed header persists at the top, while the main content area below it uses a flexible grid to display portfolio items.
A minimalist sans-serif typeface is used for all primary text, complemented by a subtle monospaced font for numerical labels, creating a clean and structured hierarchy.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, featuring a deep charcoal background with crisp light grey text, accented by a single vibrant red for interactive elements.
The site header remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, ensuring navigation is always accessible.
Portfolio projects are uniformly presented within a grid, each entry including a sequential number, project title, category, and date, maintaining a consistent information architecture.

technique_notes: To rebuild the visual style, use a deep charcoal background with light grey text for high contrast. Apply a clean, modern sans-serif for all primary text, and a monospaced font for subtle numerical details.

The motion system employs a CSS-based sticky positioning for the main header, keeping it fixed at the top of the browser window as the page content scrolls underneath. No other scroll-triggered reveals or animations are observed on content sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Relatively flat, with small uppercase navigation and slightly larger project titles, all using a clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous padding around grid items and in the header/footer.

standout: The site's standout feature is its stark, high-contrast dark theme combined with a minimalist, almost brutalist grid presentation of portfolio work. The use of a subtle mono font for numbering adds a unique, almost technical, touch to the otherwise clean sans-serif typography.
